dedupe_keys.name: vehicular traffic count measurements at tampere city finland updated version

description: Pirkko Kuusela and Jorma Kilpi at VTT publish inductive-loop vehicle counts for two locations in Tampere, Finland. The updated deposit provides a DAT file, a text-format explanatory document and a location image, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Counts have fifteen-minute resolution and cover 2011–2014. They were used in a study of origin-destination matrix estimation with a conditionally binomial model. The measurements can calibrate local traffic demand or compare origin-destination inference methods in simulation experiments. Two detector locations do not represent all city traffic, and missing-data treatment, lane aggregation and detector accuracy require checking against the documentation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this time series. The measurements were not downloaded, and neither the published estimation method nor continuity of every interval was independently verified.
